_comment: Fixed scenario set for scripts/token-bench.mjs (Phase 1 P17). Version 2.
Every sample opens a NEW v2 chat (one chat per scenario sample; every turn of
a multi-turn scenario reuses that chat). The bench reseeds its temp workspace
before each sample (notes.txt ~10 KB, data/part-1..3.txt ~10 KB each).
`mode` is sent explicitly; auto modes are refused, so the classifier never runs.
`expectTools`: the scenario should make at least one tool round trip (hops > 1).
A real run fails when it does not; a --fake run only warns.
Change a prompt, a seed file or this file's version only together with a new
token-baseline.json. Bump `version` on any such change.

turns: Read notes.txt and explain in three sentences what it is about.
In notes.txt, change the first word 'alpha' to 'beta' and tell me when it is done.
Plan one step: add a second line to notes.txt that says 'gamma'.
Remember the code word is 'amber'. Reply with OK only.
What code word did I ask you to remember? Reply with the word only.
Read data/part-1.txt, data/part-2.txt and data/part-3.txt. For each one, give its first heading.
Which of the three files has the most lines? Answer with the file name only.
Remember the code word is 'cedar'. Reply with OK only.
What code word did I ask you to remember? Reply with the word only.
